visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a black and beige sports tank top and navy blue shorts, stands in a kitchen-like indoor setting. She speaks directly to the camera with expressive facial movements and wide hand gestures. (2) She holds up a pair of small pink safety scissors, bringing them close to the lens to show the rounded tips, then mimes inserting them into her nostril with a pained expression. (3) She presents a small silver cylindrical mechanical tool, rotating it between her fingers. A small graphic overlay showing a cross-section of the tool's blades appears on the right. (4) She holds a thin yellow stick with a spiraled tip, demonstrating its use by placing it near her nose and twisting it. (5) A man in a blue t-shirt enters the frame; she applies the yellow stick tool to his nose while he looks slightly uncomfortable. A close-up shows the tool resting on a white tissue with small dark hair particles. (6) The scene shifts to an office environment where another man sits at a desk with a laptop. She approaches him with the silver tool. (7) She hands the man a 500-dollar bill. He then uses the silver tool while looking into his phone's reflection. (8) A final shot shows the woman gesturing with both arms wide open against a wall while the man continues to examine the tool results.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Problem -> Comparison of Tools -> Practical Testing -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a humorous product demonstration and review comparing different types of nose hair removal tools. It uses a high-energy, comedic approach to showcase the effectiveness of a manual trimmer and a stick-style tool through live testing on male subjects, eventually concluding with a playful call to action.
